tex_content.html:
\begin{example} \end{example}[Nonlinear elasticity and polyconvexity] ↗ def:polyconvex-lagrangian 1. ch8:8.2.4-ex-1\group Existence of Minimizers

For a hyperelastic body in dimension $n=3$, the displacement minimizes \[ I[\mathbf{w}] := \int _U L(D\mathbf{w}, x)\, dx \] over $\mathcal A$. A density of the form \[ L(P,x)=F(P,\det P,x) \] records both deformation gradients and local volume change. See Ball \cite{Ball1977}. \end{example}
